anohitasota.p: [Na+ohitasota] (ti) CL=8 The person who does not have the ear which is - well-place - not wander - concentrate, who does not have the ear to - listen to - lead to - fall for -
a: အနောဟိတသောတ(တိ)

B:
anohitasota：anohitasota（ti）
အနောဟိတသောတ（တိ）
[na+ohitasota]
[န+ဩဟိတသောတ]
K:
anohitasota：＂အနောဟိတသောတ（တိ）
[န+ဩဟိတသောတ]
ကောင်းစွာ ထားအပ်သော-မပျံ့လွင့်-စူးစိုက်-သော နားမရှိသော၊ ထောင်အပ်သော-ရှေးရှူညွတ်စေ-အပ်သော-နားမရှိသော၊ သူ။
R:
anohitasota：အနောဟိတ-သောတ（တိ）
နားမစိုက်သော။
CPD: an-ohita-sota , mfn. [ sa. an-avahita + śrotas], 'not lending an ear', inattentive; ~o an-upaniso hoti, AN l 198, 27 ( opp. ohita-soto).

anohāya.p: [Na+ohāya] (kri,vi) CL=8 Not leaving behind / sacrificing
a: အနောဟာယ(ကြိ၊ဝိ)
မစွန့်မူ၍။

B:
anohāya：anohāya（kri，vi）
အနောဟာယ（ကြိ၊ဝိ）
[na+ohāya]
[န+ဩဟာယ]
K:
anohāya：＂အနောဟာယ（ကြိ၊ဝိ）
[န+ဩဟာယ]
မစွန့်မူ၍။
DOP: ohāya ind. [ absol. of *o 2 + jahati; S. avahāya], leaving behind; abandoning ; Vin II 212, 24 (bhikkhū … Sāriputtaṃ ekakaṃ ohāya pakkamiṃsu); D I 115, 13 (samaṇo Gotamo mahantaṃ ñātisaṅghaṃ ohāya pabbajito); S V 96, 18 (yādisake kāme ohāya agārasmā anāgāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti); Thī 298 (taṃ maṃ rūpavatiṃ santiṃ kassa ohāya gacchasi); Ja III 495, 12* (aphalaṃ dumaṃ ohāya sakuṇā yanti); V 359, 26* (ohāya maṃ ñātigaṇā … anapekkhamānā gacchanti); Bv 24:15 (ohāyāhaṃ mahārajjaṃ); Mil 301, 3 (kotūhalasaddaṃ ohāya); Ps IV 218, 4 (candamaṇḍalaṃ ohāya taṃ cakkaratanaṃ abhimukhaṃ hoti); Dhp-a II 55, 20 (atha naṃ … anicchamānaṃ ohāya agamaṃsu); Pj II 514, 23 (imā maṃ ohāya kīḷantī ti); — anohāya , not leaving behind; taking ; Ps III 162, 19 (hatthaṃ viya pādaṃ viya anohāy’ eva gantabbaṃ hoti); Vibh-a 26, 32 (dvinnaṃ purisānaṃ aññamaññaṃ anohāya ekappamāṇen’ eva gamanaṃ); — see also avahāya, ohāyitvā, ohīyati.
